The system enforces a staged rollout from 0% to 100%, with each step contingent on shadow performance and drill validation. The absence of live mechanisms implies a static, theoretical framework awaiting integration. Failure modes include premature ramping due to stale drills or misreported shadow metrics, which would violate the safety kernel. The system's dual nature reflects a duality between deterministic control logic and stochastic operational behavior.
